# 2 Baruch Chapter 79 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**79:1** "And-do-not-be-troubled concerning-the-things-that-have-befallen-you, that-the-enemy-has-prevailed-over-you; for-you-were-visited with-chastisement on-account-of-your-sins."

**79:2** "But-if-you-will-turn-from-your-evil-ways, and-amend-your-deeds, you-will-be-delivered-again by-the-hand-of-the-Mighty-One."

**79:3** "For-he-is-merciful whom-you-have-hoped-in; and-he-is-good to-those-who-turn-to-him; and-he-is-a-witness-to-all-his-deeds, and-he-will-judge-every-one-of-his-creatures in-righteousness."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
